communicated_thesis: A deterministic diagram, chart and table preserve one synthetic evidence model.

sources.source_locator: Synthetic fixture generated for PRES-06 acceptance

slides.body: Synthetic fixture only; all figures and labels are illustrative.

claims.statement: The diagram, chart and table are generated from declared source data.

slides.notes: No customer or confidential data is present.

slides.action_title: Evidence flows through a bounded model
slides.body: The editable source remains available as JSON beside rendered outputs.

exhibits.alternative_text: Diagram: source evidence flows to a canonical model and then to three output formats.

slides.notes: Diagram nodes and edges come from a bounded synthetic JSON model.

slides.action_title: Synthetic quarterly growth is 12 to 18 percent
slides.body: Values are illustrative and have no real-world source.

exhibits.alternative_text: Bar chart showing q1 at 12 percent and q2 at 18 percent from a synthetic baseline.

slides.notes: Chart points are derived from q1 and q2; retain units and dates.

slides.action_title: Table values match the chart source references
slides.body: Rows are rendered from the same canonical data references used by the chart.

exhibits.alternative_text: Table of synthetic quarterly growth values and provenance.

slides.notes: Data values are intentionally repeated in the canonical data model, not exhibit markup.

slides.action_title: Synthetic evidence is preserved across modes
slides.body: Each output receipt records source identity, provenance, and any explicit fallback.
slides.notes: No real user or customer content was supplied.
